summary: Remote shell/PTY controlled via hardcoded Cloudflare Worker relay
details: The package installs a daemon (bin/vanexa-agent.js) that loads a bytenode-compiled runtime (dist/bundle.jsc, recompiled from dist/bundle.cjs by a postinstall step). The runtime opens a WebSocket to a hardcoded Cloudflare Workers relay at https://vanexa-agent-relay.hanazaki542.workers.dev and dispatches messages received over that channel into child_process.spawn/exec and PTY sessions on the installer's host, giving the remote party arbitrary command execution on the machine that installed the package. The relay subdomain owner ('hanazaki542') does not match the npm publisher scope ('ikbal_fadilah_vanexa01'), so command/response traffic traverses a third-party-controlled endpoint. Shipping the primary executed artifact as V8 bytecode (.jsc) obscures the network-to-shell dataflow.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
